customManagers.description: Bump GitHub Action pins inside Jinja-templated workflow files and composite actions (any *.jinja under .github/actions/). Dependabot and Renovate's native github-actions manager cannot read *.jinja, so the template's Action pins — the single source of truth for the whole fleet — are invisible to them. This scans them; downstream inherits bumps via template release + copier update. Pins are commit SHAs with the tag in a trailing `# vX` comment (SonarCloud githubactions:S7637, #694): the first matchString updates digest and comment together; the second still reads a bare `@vX` tag, so an unpinned addition is bumped rather than missed while scripts/tests/test_renovate_custom_manager.py fails it until it is pinned.

Bump the knope CLI pin passed to knope-dev/action's `version:` input inside the Jinja-templated release workflows. The action ref itself is covered by the manager above; this one tracks the CLI release that input names, which would otherwise be invisible to Renovate.

packageRules.description: The template NEVER auto-merges: Action majors are breaking and downstream inherits them via a reviewed template release. Native github-actions manager covers the template's own real workflows.
